title: Essential Off-road RC Racer's Guide
author: Dave B. Stevens
notes: 330 pages full-colour. Covers 1/10 2WD/4WD buggy, short-course & stadium truck, 1/8 eBuggy/eTruggy, stock 21.5T to modified. Written with input from world champions. Print ~US$34.95, eBook US$9.95. The single most comprehensive modern off-road reference. Part of the Dave B Stevens trilogy.

title: Essential Touring Car RC Racer's Guide
author: Dave B. Stevens
notes: 264 pages full-colour. 1/10 electric touring car. Written with support of IFMAR World Champions Marc Rheinard (3x) and Ronald Volker. eBook also available. Part of the Dave B Stevens trilogy.

title: Essential 1/12th & F1 RC Racer's Guide
author: Dave B. Stevens
notes: 153 pages full-colour, 6x9. 1/12 scale and F1 pan cars. Input from David Spashett (3x 1/12 World Champion) and Jan Ratheisky (2018 F1 World Champion). Print US$29.95, eBook US$29.95 (or +US$7.95 with print). Part of the Dave B Stevens trilogy.

title: HUDY Off-road Set-Up Book (1/8 off-road & truggy)
author: HUDY (Martin Hudy / team)
notes: ~50-56 pages with pro tips and ~140 images. Free PDF download. This is the off-road edition; the project's existing KB is already HUDY-sourced. ALREADY OBTAINABLE.

title: HUDY On-road / Touring Car Set-Up Book
author: HUDY (Martin Hudy / team)
concepts_covered: in-depth theory of all on-road setup adjustments
notes: Updated set-up book (2018 refresh per RedRC). Covers 1/10 & 1/12 on-road/pan. Free PDF from HUDY/EuroRC; also sold as printed booklet (~part 209100). ALREADY OBTAINABLE.

title: THE Guide (General)
author: Joern Neumann / JQ Products team
notes: JQRacing's famous free setup guide, written in plain prose (not a sheet). Available as downloadable PDF in multiple languages (English/German/Italian etc.). PDFs at eu.jqracing.com/files/PDFs/. Copyright JQ Products. ALREADY OBTAINABLE.

title: The R/C Car Bible: How to Build, Tune and Drive Electric and Nitro-powered Radio Control Cars On and Off Road
author: Robert Schleicher
notes: Fully illustrated general reference. Also available as Kindle eBook. A broad 'bible' aimed at hobbyist-to-racer; less competition-deep than Stevens/HUDY but good for fundamentals and cross-category breadth.

title: Ultimate Nitro Engine Guide for Radio-Control Vehicles
author: unknown (Air Age / RC Car Action staff compilation)
notes: 202-page paperback, color photos/graphs. ENGINE/NITRO focused only -> directly OUT OF SCOPE for the advisor's deterministic advice (D13 refuses engine/nitro tuning). Useful as background/context, NOT as a citable KB source for tuning rules.

title: XXX-MAIN: RC Touring Car Chassis Setup Guide
author: Martin Crisp
notes: 66-page paperback, 2002. Touring-car specific but widely recommended as a clear general-knowledge primer. A scanned PDF circulates (Scribd) but legality is uncertain; treat as paid. Older equipment but the chassis theory remains valid.

title: RC-Car Fahrwerktechnik: Grundlagen, Theorie und Praxis
author: Dr. Achim Schulz
notes: German. Author is a Porsche Motorsport chassis engineer + 30-yr RC racer/constructor. The most rigorous first-principles vehicle-dynamics treatment in RC. Also available as Kindle eBook and print-on-demand. Translation needed but the physics is gold for grounding the advisor's 'why'.

title: RC-Car Tuning-Tipps: Praxishandbuch fuer Elektro- und Verbrennermodelle
author: Stefan Ahlborn
notes: German practical handbook for both electric and nitro, on- and off-road. Broad but shallower than Schulz; good practitioner tips. Translation needed.

title: RC Sprint Car Dirt Oval Setup Bible: The Complete Tuning & Driving Guide for Winning Races
author: Roy Mattie
notes: Recent (Sept 2025) self-published title. Niche: RC sprint car / dirt oval. Oval-specific concepts (stagger, side bias) are mostly outside RaceLab's current touring/buggy scope, but useful if oval is ever added.

title: RC Racing: It's More Than Just A Hobby
author: K.M.S. Publishing.com
notes: 96-page beginner mini-guide, also Kindle. Very introductory and dated equipment-wise; thin on real setup depth. Low priority for grounding.

title: Team Associated RC Cheat Sheets
author: Team Associated
notes: 29-page PDF, 90+ cheat sheets + 70+ photos. Free download (also a Team Associated app/ebook). Compact cross-category quick-reference. The old RC10T3/B4 tuning booklets are folded into this. ALREADY OBTAINABLE.

title: RC Handbook (V2)
author: Team Associated
notes: Free PDF e-book from Team Associated. Good clean fundamentals reference, broadly applicable. ALREADY OBTAINABLE.

title: Tamiya R/C Guide Book (recurring series, Vol. 1-24+)
author: Tamiya (RC editorial team)
concepts_covered: RC Start Guide (build & set up to run straight)
notes: A4, ~40 pages full-colour, twice-yearly. Beginner/scale-leaning, lighter on competition setup theory. English editions exist. Useful for entry-level concept wording and Tamiya-specific context.

title: Radio Control Car Setting Know-How Compendium (ラジコンカー セッティング ノウハウ大全)
author: RC World editorial team (RCワールド編集部)
notes: Japanese (Mook). References models like Tamiya TA07 PRO and Yokomo BD8, so reasonably modern. Captures the strong Japanese touring-car tuning culture. Translation needed; availability outside Japan limited.

title: The Science of Setup (compiled column series)
author: Bob Wright (RC Crew Chief)
concepts_covered: roll center and camber gain relationship
notes: Not a bound book but a rigorous multi-part column (republished on LiveRC and archived at Petit RC). Uses RC Crew Chief software to illustrate geometry. Excellent free 'why it works' grounding material. ALREADY OBTAINABLE.

title: Setup Black Book
author: Danny Bartholomew
notes: By Danny Bartholomew (2001 ROAR Carpet Oval National Champion). Older free resource archived online; quality solid but dated. Verify currency before citing. ALREADY OBTAINABLE.

title: Murfdogg Chassis Tuning 101 (Dirt Oval Chassis Tuning Guide)
author: Matt 'Murfdogg' Murphy
notes: 21-page free PDF guide, widely referenced in the oval community. Oval-specific (stagger/bias) so partly outside current scope, but clear adjustment-effect explanations. ALREADY OBTAINABLE.

title: RC Cheat Sheets: Set Up Your Radio-Control Car to Win!
author: unknown (community compilation, hosted by Petit RC)
notes: Free aggregated cheat-sheet PDF archived at Petit RC. Provenance/authorship unclear (likely overlaps Team Associated cheat sheets). Verify originality before citing. ALREADY OBTAINABLE.

title: XRAY Set-Up Books (per-model: T-series touring, NT1 nitro, X12 pan, etc.)
author: XRAY / Team XRAY
notes: XRAY publishes model-specific set-up books (e.g. T1R, T3, NT1, X12) as free PDFs. Content style overlaps HUDY (same group) but tied to specific chassis. Multiple free PDFs on teamxray.com. ALREADY OBTAINABLE. Not a single ISBN'd book; treat as a family of free manuals.
